summary: Sprint 2 full backend + frontend E2E testing. Backend: 36 unit tests (test_products_and_affiliates.py, test_batch_validator.py, test_v2_analysis_and_pdf.py) + 12 new integration tests (test_sprint2_integration.py) — all 48 PASS. Frontend: admin CRUD flow (add/edit/delete affiliate), non-admin gating (link hidden + /admin/affiliates redirects to /dashboard), Products & Fixtures section renders with 4 cards, all with curated green recommendation box + Amazon.in + Google Shopping fallback links, spec zones table + region toggle + Match With Catalogue button all regression-clean. Landing page: hero-trust-products bullet reads 'Products & Fixtures Detection' and 'Catalogue-first' is gone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2927 lines — well above 700-line guideline. Sprint 2 added ~350 more lines. Strongly recommend extracting: (a) affiliate DB models + CRUD -> /app/backend/affiliates.py, (b) products detection + validator + seed -> /app/backend/products.py, (c) match engine -> /app/backend/match_engine.py. Current monolith makes future changes risky.

AdminAffiliates.jsx uses native window.confirm() for delete (screenshot-friendly but non-standard for the rest of the design system that uses sonner toasts + shadcn dialogs). Consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency.
Header.jsx role check runs on first render before /auth/me resolves — briefly the Affiliates link is missing then appears after auth hydrate. Minor UX flicker; not blocking.
AffiliateProductCreate.price_inr is Optional[str] — API accepts anything. Consider a light regex (₹ + digits + range) or auto-format on server. Not blocking.

test_products_and_affiliates.py imports from `server` — only runs correctly when pytest is invoked from /app/backend. Add /app/conftest.py or update rootdir so tests run from /app too (test_finish agents that cd to /app will otherwise ImportError).
